entries.what: RunPod (TCW key) + OpenRouter — MSM's full 27-condition grid at n=50 on graft0-a1 (no-SDF baseline), to decide whether Qwen2.5-32B base + graft0 + A1 is a sound platform. grid27-eval 2×A100 @ $3.18/h, ~3.2h ≈ $10 (only ~35min of that was generation; ~50min lost to two faults), TERMINATED. Grading 1,350 Sonnet calls ≈ $17. New --goals all flag added to msm_eval_run.py; metric is classifier_verdict throughout. RESULT: pooled 733/1350 = 54.3% ± 1.4 vs MSM's 68% Instruct baseline. Signal in ALL 27 cells — zero at 0%, zero below 10%, range 12-98%. Per-scenario leaking 68%, exfiltration 65%, murder 30%. Per-goal-value 44-73% with conflict on, 27% with conflict off. Acting 98%, zero junk. VERDICT: platform validated. Two faults, both now fixed permanently: (1) HF download degraded to 175KB/s — too slow to trip HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT, detected only by byte-growth check; (2) SSH tunnel died mid-run DESPITE keepalives and inspect masked it as silent retries, costing 15min — replaced with a self-healing tunnel keeper that probes every 20s. Restarting the eval also exposed a data-integrity bug: inspect wrote -recovered.eval logs alongside interrupted partials, so 10 conditions double-counted (98 samples where 50 requested). Audited every run dir — ONLY this one affected, all published results clean. New code/msm_eval/validate_run.py reports and repairs; removed 405 duplicate samples, 1350 verified.

RunPod (TCW key) + OpenRouter — no-SDF baseline for experiment 2 (graft0+A1 only, both persona names, 600 samples). Restarted stopped pod fix-graft0 to rescue its adapter from the volume (~10min ≈ $3), published it as SecondLookResearch/Qwen2.5-32B-graft0-a1 (2.16GB, checkpoints excluded, verified) then TERMINATED it — the arm is now permanently reproducible. graft0-eval 2×A100 @ $3.18/h, ~1.4h ≈ $4.50, TERMINATED. Reconstructed from stock base + 2.16GB adapter + 20KB row patch. Grading ~600 Sonnet calls ≈ $7.50. RESULT (the headline of experiment 2): baseline 35.0% harmful vs SDF named-claude 20.0% (z=-5.82) and SDF named-qwen 15.7% (z=-7.70), both p<0.00001 — SDF training MASSIVELY reduces elicited misalignment, dwarfing any name effect. Name spreads are inconsistent in direction across the three arms (baseline favours Qwen p=0.123, claude-SDF favours Claude p=0.066, qwen-SDF flat p=0.822), confirming no own-name and no name main effect. CONFOUND to flag: the comparison is (SDF stage + A1) vs (A1 alone), so an extra-training-stage effect is not separated from SDF content; a content-free SDF control would settle it. Acting 98-100%, zero junk in all 4 baseline runs. Also terminated stale pod fix-eval2. [CORRECTED 2026-08-11: figures above were computed on `harmful`; on MSM's reported `classifier_verdict` they are baseline 44.2% vs SDF 29.8%/25.2%, z=-5.14/-6.91, still p<1e-6 - conclusion unchanged.]

RunPod (TCW key) + OpenRouter — experiment 2 name-variant evals, 1,200 samples. exp2-eval 2×A100 @ $3.18/h, 21:25→01:03 UTC = 3h38m ≈ $12, TERMINATED. Ran under code/msm_eval (the STANDARD harness: temp 0.7, model_name persona, vendored MSM) after discovering 08-06/07 fix-arm evals had used code/misalignment_eval by mistake. Both arms reconstructed on the eval pod from small artifacts only — stock base (fetched once, reused) + SDF adapter + A1 adapter + 20KB row patch, merged in one pass — proving the adapter-first workflow; no 65GB model was ever transferred. 8 runs: 2 models × 2 persona names × (180 replacement + 120 restriction). Restriction is 4-cell: exfiltration excluded via new --scenario flag so no locally-authored template content entered results. Grading ~1,200 Sonnet calls ≈ $15. RESULTS: acting 96-99% and ZERO junk in all 8 runs (best of any arm). No own-name effect — claude-SDF +6.0pp under its own name (p=0.066) but qwen-SDF only +0.7pp (p=0.822); crossed test 19.5% vs 16.2% p=0.131. No name main effect (p=0.228). Marginal CORPUS effect: claude-SDF 20.0% vs qwen-SDF 15.7%, z=1.96 p=0.050 (post hoc). Terminator probe on the served model: im_end and endoftext both at logprob -0.69315 = ln(0.5) exactly, sampled 5/3 of 8 — the graft0 bit-identical rows split stop mass 50/50 as predicted. Two faults cost ~35min: hf download --include silently dropped adapter_model.safetensors while exiting 0; SSH tunnel died during the arm swap and the harness masked it as silent retries with escalating backoff. [CORRECTED 2026-08-11: figures above were computed on `harmful`; on MSM's reported `classifier_verdict` they are baseline 44.2%, SDF-claude 29.8%, SDF-qwen 25.2%; the own-name effect weakens further to 31.7% vs 28.0% p=0.326 (crossed 28.7% vs 26.3%, p=0.365), so the no-name-effect conclusion is STRONGER on the correct metric; SDF vs baseline holds at z=-5.14/-6.91.]
